## What & why

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New lint rule / rule change
- [ ] New feature or output format

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run check:bytes` passes
- [ ] `npm run check:docs` passes (ran `npm run build` first)
- [ ] Rule changes: updated `docs/rules.md` and, if coverage changed, `COVERAGE.md`
- [ ] Notable user-facing changes recorded under `## [Unreleased]` in the changelog
- [ ] **This change keeps stripe-audit read-only — it introduces no write calls to the Stripe API**
